patches.name: Block client-requested ads
patches.description: Blocks native player ad requests. Restart Twitch after changing this setting.

patches.name: Hide feed and display ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored feed cards, banners and display ads.

patches.name: Block stream ads
patches.description: Replaces detected preroll and midroll ads with direct Twitch playback.

patches.name: Auto-claim bonus channel points
patches.description: Automatically claims bonus channel points while watching live streams.

patches.name: Show deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps deleted and moderated chat messages readable.

patches.name: Favorite emotes
patches.description: Adds a Favorites section to the emote picker, filled from the picker and from emote cards.

patches.name: BTTV, FFZ and 7TV emotes
patches.description: Adds global and channel emotes to chat, autocomplete and the emote picker, with animations and input previews.

patches.name: Hide subscription discount banners
patches.description: Hides subscription offers, discount banners and promotional labels.

patches.name: Hide Turbo promotions
patches.description: Hides Twitch Turbo promotions and purchase prompts.

patches.name: Reload stream
patches.description: Reloads live streams with a double-tap control.

patches.name: UI settings
patches.description: Customizes player controls, channel actions, extensions, Hype Trains, leaderboards and fullscreen system bars.
